flags.title: Valuation blind-spot
flags.note: Rich valuation — P/E 82, P/B 7.0, DCF overvalued 93%. A market-beating chart doesn't make a rich entry safe; the price already discounts a lot of the good news.
flags.lesson: KPIT: strong EV/software story, valuation ignored → about −30%.

flags.title: Turnaround vs. sentiment
flags.note: Results are improving (results score 98/100, net profit +584% YoY, accelerating) while the price/verdict stays cautious. Don't dismiss a turnaround on stale sentiment.
flags.lesson: Union Bank: sold the 'dull PSU' near the bottom (about ₹48), missed the re-rating to ₹140+.

opportunities.point: Management stated its medium-term aspiration is to achieve approximately INR1,000 crores in revenue by FY28.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "As shared earlier, our medium-term aspirations remain to achieve approximately INR1,000 crores in revenue by FY28." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company expects an organic growth of 10% to 15% every year over and above the annualized run rate of INR800 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "And we are expecting organic growth of 10%-15% on every year basis, that is point number one." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The Guwahati facility was successfully commissioned and revamped, enhancing capabilities in soap noodles and cosmetics.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The successful commissioning and revamp of our Guwahati facility has enhanced our capabilities in soap noodles and cosmetics while improving our reach in the Northeast and other adjacent markets." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that the INR1,000 crores revenue target can be achieved using existing capacities without major capex investments.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "So this INR1,000 crores turnover can be achieved with the existing capacity and we don't see much of the expansion or investment in the capex side for achieving this INR1,000 crores topline." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies 27.2% earnings growth vs 97% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: Management stated that India's FMCG sector continues to offer attractive long-term growth potential.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "India's FMCG sector continues to offer attractive long-term growth potential supported by rising consumption, increasing penetration, and growing demand across categories." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Personal care and home care are the categories currently contributing substantially to the FMCG business.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "In the FMCG category, both in the personal care and home care, these two are the categories which are contributing substantially as of now." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Sunrakshakk operates a manufacturing network across Bhilwara, Roorkee, and Guwahati, combined with a customer base of over 200 customers.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Our manufacturing network across Bhilwara, Roorkee, and Guwahati combined with a customer base of over 200 customers provides a strong foundation for our future growth." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Cosmetics capacity utilization at the Guwahati plant is around 45% to 50%.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "So in our Guwahati unit, the cosmetics segment we are utilizing our capacity at around 45% to 50% for Guwahati." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Management is working toward achieving an internal target of 7% PAT margin in the near future.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "We are, we have taken an internal target of achieving PAT at the rate 7% in the near future, and we are working on it." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company maintains its focus on achieving an aspiration of approximately ₹1,000 crore in revenue by FY28.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "With a diversified portfolio, expanding customer base, and majority revenues now coming from FMCG and FMCG Intermediates, we remain focused on sustaining growth momentum and achieving our aspiration of approximately ₹1,000 crore in revenue by FY28, while..."
